Update19 February 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes - Feb 19, 2026
Phoenix Ashes wrap-up: Divine Clock ends Saturday 6 AM server time; mentor/mentee quests + Musperosa chest tweaked through the 25th. Two-week Ahnimar Founders Festival with timed dailies. Serpentis follow-ups: categorization fixes, crates, sapphire balance and imaging workflow, pirate spawn rotates for Veroe Festival.

📜 Patch Notes - Feb 19, 2026

Applies after maintenance https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1137029231277244417/1473979288746459229

Phoenix Ashes: Event End Schedule

  • The Divine Clock will end SATURDAY, 6AM Server Time
  • Due to some issues with Mentor/Mentee quests, those will be extended until the 25th
    • Musperosa's Secret Chest has been adjusted to work well with multiple mentors/mentees.
    • Mentor Interacts => Mentee Interacts => The chest opens and all mentors/mentees can grab seals

Ahnimar's Founders Festival is starting!

  • The Festival will run for 2 weeks, until the 4th of March
  • Daily quests will be availble in Ahnimar and a World Gate will spawn in all Capitals
  • Daily Special Quests will be available at 1PM, 7PM and Midnight SERVER TIME
  • ⚠ Changes from previous years
    • The daily materials quest will not be 50x Iron Ingots but 100x Lumber for 6 Tokens.

Sapphire Serpentis Changes

  • Fixed categorization for Serpentis Armor and Weapons to Dungeon Armor and Weapons
  • Added descriptions to the Serpentis Armory Crates
  • The Veiled Terror Buff incorrectly showed 5%, it will now display the proper value 10%
  • Serpentis Armor item levels were not correctly updated. They have been increased to 53 as announced previously
  • Sirothe's Hatred model size has been reduced slightly
  • Sirothe's Hatred item level has been decreased from 62 (Ayanad) to 59 (Obsidian T6) to be in line with other Sapphire weapons
  • All Sapphire Active Skills have been updated to use shared cooldowns with their non-Sapphire versions
  • Serpentis & Sapphire weapons can no longer be imaged directly. Instead, you'll be able to craft them into Image Items (same costs) ## Veroe Festival Changes
  • The Pirate Spawn has been moved and is now located on the small road between West and East spawns
  • East and West spawns have been swapped
    • We will do this swap every few months

== 📜 Patch Notes - Feb 19, 2026 ==

Applies after maintenance https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1137029231277244417/1473979288746459229

== Phoenix Ashes: Event End Schedule ==

* The Divine Clock will end SATURDAY, 6AM Server Time
* Due to some issues with Mentor/Mentee quests, those will be extended until the 25th
** Musperosa's Secret Chest has been adjusted to work well with multiple mentors/mentees.
** Mentor Interacts => Mentee Interacts => The chest opens and all mentors/mentees can grab seals

== Ahnimar's Founders Festival is starting! ==
* The Festival will run for 2 weeks, until the 4th of March
* Daily quests will be availble in Ahnimar and a World Gate will spawn in all Capitals
* Daily Special Quests will be available at 1PM, 7PM and Midnight SERVER TIME
* ⚠ Changes from previous years
** The daily materials quest will not be 50x Iron Ingots but 100x Lumber for 6 Tokens.

== Sapphire Serpentis Changes ==
* Fixed categorization for Serpentis Armor and Weapons to Dungeon Armor and Weapons
* Added descriptions to the Serpentis Armory Crates
* The Veiled Terror Buff incorrectly showed 5%, it will now display the proper value '''10%'''
* Serpentis Armor item levels were not correctly updated. They have been increased to '''53''' as announced previously
* Sirothe's Hatred model size has been reduced slightly
* Sirothe's Hatred item level has been decreased from 62 (Ayanad) to 59 (Obsidian T6) to be in line with other Sapphire weapons
* All Sapphire Active Skills have been updated to use shared cooldowns with their non-Sapphire versions
* Serpentis & Sapphire weapons can no longer be imaged directly. Instead, you'll be able to craft them into Image Items (same costs) ## Veroe Festival Changes
* The Pirate Spawn has been moved and is now located on the small road between West and East spawns
* East and West spawns have been swapped
** We will do this swap every few months
